name: tetris-analyzes
description: Bun workspace for Tetris fumen tooling with native bitboard helpers.

scripts.bench: bun run bench/bitboard.bench.ts && bun run bench/search-opener.bench.ts && bun run bench/opener-regression.bench.ts
scripts.bench:release: bun run build:native && bun run bench
scripts.experiment:opener: bun run build:native && bun run scripts/run-opener-experiment.ts
scripts.verify: bun run build:native:debug && bun run check && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test:native && bun test
